title: Tree
description: Fiori tree: nested items with expand/collapse (→ / ←), indentation levels and the List selection modes.

usage.summary: Browse or select hierarchical items through expandable parent-child nodes.
useWhen: Let users browse or select items in a meaningful parent-child hierarchy.
Keep relationships visible through expansion and collapse instead of flattening them into group headers.
Use selectionMode="single" or "multiple" for selection and onItemToggle for expansion; expanded and onExpandedChange control individual nodes.

avoidWhen.when: Present flat items or only group headers with one item level.
Choose one nonhierarchical field value: Select covers 2–12 fixed options without typing (sort alphabetically above 8), and ComboBox covers type-ahead across 20–200.
Compare flat record attributes in columns: Table suits roughly 200 loaded rows without built-in sorting; DataTable adds sorting and virtualization, with a design rethink above 1,000.
